description: The EUMETSAT Data Store is the online catalogue and download service of the European meteorological satellite organisation. The search page read on 2026-09-28 renders by script, so its public browse service was read instead: it lists 188 collections holding about 70.4 million products, with identifiers covering Meteosat, Metop instruments such as AVHRR and ocean and atmosphere products, and the site offers search, a cart and API access. Coverage is global and full-disk, depending on the satellite. Access to browsing is open; downloading needs a free user account, and the EUMETSAT data policy and licence terms were not read. Caveats: collections range from raw instrument data to derived products, so each needs its own product guide, and near-real-time products are large. It supports hazard exposure and emergency response studies, such as mapping convective storms, fire radiative power or flood extent around infrastructure. Related record: the Chinese NSMC centre offers the Fengyun equivalent.
